correctness.rationale: Fix I+aα and write a second transvection as I+bβ using a single representative b for each image line. The product minus identity is N=aα+bβ+α(b)aβ. With s=α(b), t=β(a), c=st≠0, the active span ⟨a,b⟩ has N-matrix [[c,s],[t,0]] and splits off from the fixed space. The active product is nonscalar, thus cyclic even at a repeated root, and has polynomial X²−(2+c)X+1 with value −c at 1. There are q^(n−1) lines with s≠0 and q^(n−2) forms with prescribed t=c/s. At c=0, N³=0 and N²=XY+YX (X=aα, Y=bβ), with exactly one nonzero rank-one summand when exactly one of s,t is nonzero; rank N≤2 then forces one J_3. Each such stratum has q^(2n−3)−q^(n−1) choices. At s=t=0, N is square-zero. For the common image line there is one cancellation and q^(n−1)−2 rank-one choices; for each of the L−1 other lines in ker α the q−1 nonzero multiples of α give rank one and the remaining q^(n−2)−q forms give rank two. This verifies every class count and omission at n=2,3. Counting projective lines times forms gives H, and conjugation gives the ordered-pair and probability normalizations. The source checker was inspected, not executed. An independent bounded check enumerated nonzero square-zero 2×2 matrices over F_2[x]/(x²+x+1) and multiplied I+X on the left by [[1,1],[0,1]]; it found one identity, two nonidentity unipotents and four products for each nonzero trace (trace equals trace shift in characteristic two). The algebraic count, not enumeration, covers all fields and dimensions.
residual_risks: The supplied checker only uses prime fields. The independent extension-field check only covers (n,q)=(2,4) and does not constitute formal certification.
